body:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up from the storage-surge. We agreed to update the runbook with a clear triage checklist, explicit paging steps, and a small section on recurring patterns + mitigations. Who picks which?

maya: I can take the triage checklist. I'll add step-by-step PromQL and kubectl commands and a tiny verification matrix.

jon: I'll own the paging/escalation edits and make sure alert owners are set. Also will add the recommended 15-min routing mitigation to the playbook.

alex: Thanks. Can the triage checklist include the exact alert names and thresholds we discussed? That saves guesswork on-call.

maya: Yes. Planned checks (to be added to runbook):

# First-responder canonical commands
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide
POD=$(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=10m | egrep "evict|kv_warm|oom"

# PromQL quick checks
sum(rate(cache_eviction_total[1m]))
avg_over_time(kv_warmup_duration_seconds[5m])
// quick saved query: Dashboard: Inference / Cache -> cache_hit_ratio

maya: Alert names to reference: AlertCacheEvictionHigh, AlertKVWarmSlow, AlertCacheHitLow. Temporary thresholds: eviction_rate > 2/min for 3m, kv_warmup_duration_seconds > 12s for 5m, cache_hit_ratio < 0.7 for 5m.

jon: I'll map those to L1/L2 contacts. Paging ladder: L1=inference-oncall, L2=infra-sre, L3=runtime-eng. I'll confirm backup contacts and set owners in the alert dashboard.

alex: Add a short recurring-patterns appendix: what to check if evictions recur across hosts (hint: check GC cycles, node memory pressure, and recent deploys). Also add instructions to run the canary routing play to move traffic to the smaller-context model for 10-15m.

maya: I'll include the routing play in the triage PR as an optional mitigation with smoke-check steps.

pagerbot: Linked postmortem: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/storage-surge-19611>. Actions created: INC-3247. Reminder: review PRs on 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC.

alex: Owners and due dates:
- maya: triage checklist + commands + PR -> 2026-04-02
- jon: escalation ladder + alert owners -> 2026-04-04
- maya: routing mitigation + smoke check -> 2026-04-05
- alex: review thresholds & merge -> 2026-04-06

jon: I'll add an FAQ entry in the runbook: "When to escalate to L2 for eviction spikes" and link to the saved queries.

maya: Opening PR today and will tag INC-3247 in the description.

alex: Great. This thread is the canonical action list. Ping here if anything slips.
